title: Taskmarket RFC index
description: Schema for docs/rfc/index.yaml — the structured, generated source of truth for the RFC index. Auto-generated by packages/adr/adr-audit.ts; never hand-edited. docs/rfc/README.md's own index list is a rendered view of this same data.

rfcs.description: One entry per RFC file in docs/rfc/, sorted by number.

number.description: The RFC's 4-digit number, as a string to preserve leading zeros.

file.description: Filename of the RFC within docs/rfc/, matching FILENAME_RE.

title.description: The RFC's title, from its '# NNNN — Title' header line.

status.description: The RFC's own **Status:** field value; 'unknown' means the field was missing or unparseable.

date.description: The RFC's own **Date:** field value; 'unknown' means the field was missing or unparseable.
